propositions: Standalone completion-verifier runs outside a close transition must record their result on the ticket for reuse by a later close at the same ref, eliminating duplicate billable verifier invocations.

A new producer function record_completion_verdict signs attested certifiable PASS verdicts pinned to verified_at_sha via sign_completion_verdict, emits a COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar, and never signs or raises on local/uncertifiable/non-PASS outcomes.
The rebar verify-completion CLI records verdicts by default with a --no-sign opt-out flag, reporting what was recorded in text output.
The MCP verify_completion tool records unless the server is read-only, with the outcome recorded on the result's record field.

A standalone attested PASS is signed and reused by a later same-ref close without invoking the verifier provider, while --no-sign, local source, certifiable=False, and FAIL each record without signing.
